verdict.rationale: Milvus is fundamentally API/SDK-first (PyMilvus/MilvusClient), with no distinct GUI that offers capabilities beyond the API — all core operations (collection management, CRUD, ANN search, filtering, multi-vector, RBAC, multi-tenancy) are documented as API/SDK operations, and Milvus Lite/Standalone/Distributed share the same client-side API surface. missing for 10: no explicit comparison against the Attu GUI to confirm 1:1 parity, and no published OpenAPI/REST spec (probe shows 404s) confirming a fully documented REST surface alongside the SDK.
